snippet.title: Beefy Boi | Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
Beefy Boi's playtest is going live, and we want YOUR help to test play it. Get the order, gather ingredients from the freezer, assemble the burger and reach your quota. Oh also watch out for Mr. Meat, he's a giant lumbering meat monster who is also your boss. At the end of your shift, clock out and run home to evade Mr. Meat. He can be obsessive.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513510/Beefy_Boi/

#indiegame #horrorgaming #simulator #announcement
